title.en: MALACAÑAN PALACE BY THE PRESIDENT OF THE PHILIPPINES ORGANIZING THE BARRIO OF TUNGA, MUNICIPAL- ITY OF BARUGO, PROVINCE OF LEYTE, INTO AN INDEPENDENT MUNICIPALITY UNDER THE NAME OF TUNGA.

text.en:
OFFICIAL GAZETTE
The municipality of Tunga shall begin to exist upon the
appointment and qualification of the mayor, vice-mayor,
and a majority of the councilors thereof.
Done in the City of Manila, this 21th day of September,
in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and forty-nine,
and of the Independence of the Philippines, the fourth.
ELPIDIO QUIRINO
President of the Philippines
3733
By the President:
MENTORO EVANGELISTA
Frecutive Secretary
